hotel_name: Collection O By Oyo The Crystal Palace.

positive_snippets: This is an wonderful banquet hall and Hotel to celebrate your precious events . Here you can get all the things to organise your any kind of event ...it's  fully air-conditioned..also you can organise terrace party there ..staff is very polite cooperative and understanding ...Food quality, decor, furnishing is better than most. Location is just near  to main road approx 200 mtr, easily accessible. Spacious. Recommended.
negative_snippets:
I've had itching on my skin for a week after staying here.
Gave me a broken room with wiry bed and a broken lock when another was empty, receptionist lied to my face about room availability, tried to give me a higher cost room than their usual amount (which i came to know by chance later on).

All this i could forgive, but the itchy skin is crazy. Wash your sheets you disgusting people!!
